training_notes.summary: Train corpus: intact in-pool snapshot comps + approved synth v2 + scrubbed thin150; heroes/trinkets/spells as SUPPORT. T7 optional. Naga out. No Firestone/VODs.
training_notes.detail: Active comps=16 (kept 11 + synth 5). Thin150 clean=72 (dirty excluded=78). Comps highest weight; heroes/trinkets/spells support examples via hsreplay_snapshot_dataset. T7 minions are useful additions but NOT required. Excluded tribes: naga. Sources: data/hsreplay/36.6.1 + data/train_synth_comps_v2.json + data/train_perfect_thin150_clean.

training_notes.summary: Tier-7 minions are useful adds but NOT required for any train archetype.
training_notes.detail: T7 minions are useful additions when they fit the plan, but they are NOT required. Do not treat Tier-7 as mandatory for this archetype; cores/keys/example boards stay <=T6.

training_notes.summary: Aberrations are strong early–mid; plan to transition into another comp later rather than forcing all-Aberration endgame.
training_notes.detail: Community read for patch 36.6.1: Aberration boards win early/mid tempo and value, then pivot into a stronger late tribe/comp. Treat Aberration pieces as a launchpad; do not tunnel into weak Aberration end boards when a transition is available. Blood Gems are good discard fodder for Aberration discard synergies.
training_notes.train_hint: Prefer Aberration buys early; after mid-game, weight pivots into lobby-strong comps higher than staying pure Aberration.

training_notes.summary: Murlocs are stronger; Murloc scam uses Activate to put Venomous+Stealth on the T2 hand-summon Murloc, then floods hand scam (like Venom Scam).
training_notes.detail: Murloc scam line: use an Activate Murloc to give Venomous and Stealth to the Tier 2 Murloc that summons cards from hand (Expert Aviator style: Rally/summon highest-Attack from hand for combat). Then fill hand with more scam summon pieces, analogous to existing Murlocs - Venom Scam (comp_8). Murlocs overall improved this patch — raise prior vs prior patch.
training_notes.train_hint: When holding Activate Murlocs + hand-summon Murloc, bias toward Venomous/Stealth buffs and hand-scam density over pure stats.

training_notes.summary: Quilboar are somewhat better as a supporting tribe: Blood Gems excel when casting many spells on minions, and as Aberration discard fuel.
training_notes.detail: Quilboar rarely need to be the primary end tribe. Blood Gems are high-value when the main plan casts many spells onto minions (spell-on-minion comps), and they are strong cards to discard for Aberration synergies. Prefer Quilboar as splash/support.
training_notes.train_hint: Raise Quilboar/Blood Gem value when board plan is spell-heavy or Aberration-discard; do not force pure Quilboar unless lobby/comp demands it.

training_notes.summary: Playing tavern spells from hand is a legal action the coach must suggest when applicable.
training_notes.detail: NEXT/recommend must include play-spell actions, not only buy/roll/sell/HP. Spells are often the correct click.
training_notes.train_hint: When a spell in hand has positive EV (buff, discover, economy, combat tech), prefer PLAY_SPELL over holding or rolling past the window.

training_notes.summary: Discard is a legal action — suggest it when applicable (Aberration fodder, Sludge/Corrupted Coin double-cast, etc.).
training_notes.detail: With discard mechanics in the pool, the coach must know DISCARD as a legal action and recommend it when it enables double-casts or tribe synergies (e.g. Sludge Corrosion, Corrupted Coin, Blood Gems as Aberration discard fuel).
training_notes.train_hint: If discard doubles a spell or fuels Aberration/Quilboar lines, weight DISCARD above cycling dead cards blindly.

training_notes.summary: If the board is full, suggest selling a card before placing a new one.
training_notes.detail: Full board blocks plays from hand. Coach should name which minion to sell, then the play/buy, and keep the sell target on the NEXT line.
training_notes.train_hint: When hand-play or buy needs a board slot and board_size==max, emit SELL(<weakest off-plan>) then PLAY/BUY.

training_notes.summary: Balinda / spell-on-minion comps: always buy 1–2 cost spells that TARGET a minion.
training_notes.detail: When the plan casts many cheap targeted spells onto minions (Balinda, Demon Distractor buff lines, Weapons Forge / Pointy Arrows comps), prioritize buying 1–2 gold targeted tavern spells every time they appear.
training_notes.train_hint: If strategy is spell-on-minion density, raise buy priority for cost<=2 targeted spells above neutral economy spells.

training_notes.summary: Tier 7 tavern spells are almost never seen — do not plan the game around them.
training_notes.detail: Eyes of the Earth Mother (T6) is the real golden tool for a strong under-T4 card. Sharing is Caring / Menagerie Tableware / Sacred Gift / Hallowed Ritual are T7 rarities.
training_notes.train_hint: Do not weight lines that require hitting T7 spells; Eyes goldenizing a strong low-tier is the realistic spike.
